verdict.rationale: Brex's marketing claims "automatic syncing across 1,000s of native integrations" and syncing "from card swipe to month-end close." It also cites automated GL coding by entity and one-click accruals, and offers an Accounting API plus real-time webhooks. However, no evidence names a specific ERP or confirms that the sync is real-time or bidirectional rather than one-way export. Missing for 10: named native ERP connectors (e.g., NetSuite or Sage), documentation of bidirectional data flow, evidence of real-time ERP sync rather than batch, and independent or hands-on corroboration that it replaces manual journal entries.
